behavior.opt_in: PANTHEON_L12_HOSTED_CHAIN=1 plus PANTHEON_L12_STIMULUS_CROSS_LOOP_E2E=1; default isolated gate unchanged
behavior.child_launch: existing StimulusDrivenClosureGate._run_domain_suite with extra env (chain id, phase, input file); no second launch engine
behavior.receipt: existing atomic Evidence.write plus a hosted block: chain_id, phase, phase_status completed|paused|failed, blocked_before, resource_ids, decisions, per-phase history
behavior.resume: prior receipt is a lookup hint; every referenced owner record is re-read (tenant + chain label) and every referenced decision is re-read (decided/approved, H1 target = registry_id); mismatch pauses without launching
behavior.idempotency: a completed phase in the prior receipt is reused, not re-dispatched, only after owner records and decisions are re-read and verified (D_observe may repeat); hosted mode excludes the legacy full-chain test so only the requested phase dispatches
behavior.ordering: A_research, B_learning, C_promote, D_observe, E_close; skipping ahead raises
behavior.e_close: existing owner retire operations only for records whose GET shows verified tenant+chain label; every retire is read back (accepted != retired); rejected/unreadable/unread-back records leave E_close paused (cleanup_incomplete), never completed; E_close never reuses a prior completed receipt; H1 revoke only when the chain registry entry itself was verified
behavior.all12_passed: true only when all five phases completed, twelve loops present, and E_close baseline_fleet_check == verified (Runtime desired-state re-read equals the baseline recorded before the first C_promote mutation)
behavior.owner_request_schemas: Capital PATCH status {actor_id,actor_role,status} using executing identity (PANTHEON_L12_HOSTED_OWNER_ACTOR_ID, PANTHEON_L12_HOSTED_OWNER_ROLES) and a granted role; Governance revoke {actor_id,actor_role,expected_version from record}; Registry advance CAS body; Runtime retire {}; Deployment plan status {status}. No identity/role => incomplete, nothing fabricated
behavior.decisions: H1/H3 are objects read via decision_id; only H1 is read from Governance; H2/H4 consent objects are forwarded unchanged and never gated
behavior.entry: PANTHEON_L12_HOSTED_CHAIN_INPUT packet (chain_id, phase, decisions, predecessors) is honored and merged with prior receipt / DECISION_REFS; mismatching chain_id/phase raises

join_corrections.paused_partial_cases: on a paused phase a case that cannot be normalized is kept under phases.<phase>.partial_cases and not added to loops; completed phases still reject it
join_corrections.registry_lineage: registry entry without chain_id is accepted only when metadata.distillation.source_id equals resource_ids.source_id, contains the chain id, has a source_digest, and checksum matches; no new owner API
join_corrections.typed_ids: resource ids must be scalar nonsecret owner ids (no objects/paths); capital_pool_id/capital_binding_id/runtime_binding_id are read and retired by E_close
join_corrections.baseline: C_promote reads existing Runtime /api/runtime-fleet/desired-state before launch and carries baseline_fleet in the receipt; unreadable baseline pauses C; E_close compares and reports verified|mismatch|chain_binding_still_active|baseline_not_recorded|unreadable

assumptions_for_reviewer: child suites (T2) report chain_id, phase, phase_status, blocked_before, resource_ids, exit 0 when paused

resource_ids keys read/retired by the parent: capital_binding_id, runtime_binding_id, plan_id, capital_pool_id, registry_id (+ decisions H1); other keys are carried as references and reported residual
owner access uses PANTHEON_L12_<SERVICE>_URL and PANTHEON_L12_HOSTED_OWNER_TOKEN (real executing identity); no tokens minted
retire request bodies follow the existing suite/owner models; not exercised against a live owner
not_done: no hosted run, VM change, provider request or business approval
product hosted execution and independent restart remain original parent obligations
T2 must agree the packet 'predecessors'/'decisions' keys and the two new owner-identity env vars via native notes; not exercised against a live owner
